name: Slack
one_liner: Workplace messaging platform whose developer platform lets teams build apps, agents and integrations.
auth_notes: Gemini CLI setup uses OAuth 2.0 with the app client ID; apps use a bot token (xoxb-) and an app-level token (xapp-) for Socket Mode.
access_notes: Create an app via the Slack CLI or app settings, install it to your workspace, and copy the bot token. A free Developer Program sandbox exists; some AI features need a paid plan. Workspace admin may need to approve the MCP server.

buildability.rationale: App creation and bot tokens are self-serve per the docs; some AI features need a paid plan and the MCP server may need workspace admin approval.

identity.quote: A Slack app is a tool or integration that extends the functionality of Slack

auth.quote: set its authentication to OAuth 2.0, and enter your Slack app's client ID.

access.quote: Some AI features need a paid plan; a free Developer Program sandbox has them.

sandbox.quote: Developer sandboxes let you play around with platform features outside of a production environment.

api_surface.quote: uses the Slack SDKs (available for Python, Node, and Java) under the hood

mcp.quote: Remote MCP over HTTP with OAuth. Your workspace admin may need to approve it.

needs_human_reason: Only docs.slack.dev pages were usable; the npm page returned 403 and the pricing page was not fetched. Endpoint breadth, pagination and rate limits are not documented in the fetched pages.
